question: Who was sworn in as the Governor of Andhra Pradesh on 24 February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S Abdul Nazeer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **S Abdul Nazeer** was sworn in as the **Governor of Andhra Pradesh** on **24 February 2023**.
 
• He **succeeded Biswabhusan Harichandan**, who was appointed as the Governor of Chhattisgarh.
 
• S Abdul Nazeer is a **retired judge of the Supreme Court of India**.
 
• He is known for his contributions to several landmark judgments during his tenure in the judiciary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Governor is the **constitutional head of the state** and is **appointed by the President of India**.
 
• The Governor's role includes overseeing the functioning of the state government and ensuring it acts in accordance with the Constitution.
 
• The Governor has the power to summon and dissolve the state legislative assembly, and also to give assent to bills passed by the assembly.
 
• S Abdul Nazeer has also served on the bench that delivered the historic judgment in the Ayodhya land dispute case.
